thread:
maria: Quick check — onboarding a new service `ingest-worker`. What's the recommended pattern for secrets? Thinking: dedicated Vault role + short-lived creds, KMS envelope encryption for any exported blobs, and rotate service keys quarterly. Also need to confirm what we redact from logs.

Tom: yes to Vault role + short-lived. Use AppRole with CIDR restriction or workload identity if on cloud. Put only encrypted blobs in S3 and let KMS wrap the DEK. Avoid long-lived env vars when possible.

kevin: +1. For CI, don't put KMS keys in GH Actions secrets. Use the runner's short-lived tokens and fetch secrets at runtime. We have a GH Actions plugin that requests a Vault token via OIDC.

olivia: Do we need an access approval for the new Vault path? If team wants cross-team access we should go through the normal access request flow.

maria: good point — we will request a Vault path with limited capabilities (read only) for the worker role. Is there a standard TTL you recommend?

Tom: default TTL 1h for tokens, renewable up to 24h for workers. For long-running system daemons use rotated service account keys stored encrypted by KMS but prefer workload identity to avoid keys entirely.

sean: logging note: redact headers + tokens. Add these to the redact list: `authorization`, `x-api-key`, `set-cookie`. Example redaction regex we push to fluentd:
```
/(authorization|x-api-key|set-cookie):\s*([^\n]+)/i -> "[REDACTED]"
```
And please avoid logging full request bodies containing `password` or `secret` keys.

kevin: also run `truffleHog`/secret-scan in CI pre-merge and block if high entropy strings are found. We have a `--exclude-prefix` for common legitimate patterns.

dev-bot: Policy reminder: creating new Vault paths needs Owner approval if path matches `secret/production/*`. See https://intranet.redwood.com/security/vault-policy for the flow.

maria: thanks all — I'll open the access request and a small PR to add the redact rules + CI policy. tagging @tom to review the Vault role config and @kevin for the CI bits. Will target rotation quarterly and audit monthly.

Tom: ping me on the PR, I'll do a quick review. :thumbsup:

kevin: I can add the GH Actions OIDC snippet in the PR too.

maria: awesome, closing async — will update once the request is approved.
